description: NaNb₄Bi₅O₁₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-35°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.16 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-35°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.22 Å. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.56 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.57 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.61 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nb, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nb, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Nb, and one Bi atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Nb, and one Bi atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Nb and two Bi atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Nb and two Bi atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Nb and one Bi atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms.
